2. **paper-b**, "A held-out evaluation protocol for small synthetic datasets" (Bo Split, 2020). I recommend **leave it**, for the same reason: its abstract says the same thing. Its held-out rule (the last fifth of one seeded stream) is already in your intake and the spec as a fact of `generate.py`, not as a citation.

The paper-c tarball isn't on this list: it's kept as a reference document. The spec lists building on it as out of scope, since it isn't needed for any experiment and its contents are unread. Tell me if you want its code repository brought in.
